question: Estimate the investment opportunity (annual TAM) for solar rooftop installations in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total annual market value for rooftop solar installations? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Annual rooftop solar capacity addition target (FY26): ~5-6 GW.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Annual market value FY26: 5,500 MW × ₹55 lakh/MW = ~₹30,000 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: By FY30 annual addition target: ~12-15 GW = ~₹60,000-75,000 Cr annual market.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Annual rooftop solar capacity addition target (FY26)

calculationFlow: Average installed cost: ~₹50-60 per Watt = ₹5-6 crore per MW.
Annual market value FY26: 5,500 MW × ₹55 lakh/MW = ~₹30,000 Cr.
PM Surya Ghar Yojana target: 30 GW residential by 2027 = average 8-10 GW/year.
By FY30 annual addition target: ~12-15 GW = ~₹60,000-75,000 Cr annual market.
Plus operations & maintenance + battery + accessories: ~25% on top = additional ₹15,000-18,000 Cr.
